description: Tests that with little time left and no solution, agent is more directive but doesn't hand over code. Agent should be in time-pressure phase.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate near the end of the interview. You still don't have a working solution and you're a bit anxious about time. You've been stuck for a while. The clock is running down.
simulated_user.first_message: I'm running out of time here and I'm still not getting it to work. What should I do?

evaluation_criteria.name: More proactive under time pressure
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Given little time remains and no working solution, the agent stepped in more proactively/directly than an early-stage gentle nudge. PASS if it was noticeably more directive about the next step.

evaluation_criteria.name: Still no solution handover
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Despite being more directive, the agent did NOT give the full solution, the optimal approach by name, or code. PASS if it pushed them toward it without handing it over.

candidate_turns: I'll try nested loops — check every subarray.
I've got the loops but I'm not sure how to track the best result. I've been going in circles.
